summary: Selects additional color, depth, infrared, or point-cloud image streams from a primary Orbbec TOP.

key_params.name: image
key_params.note: Image stream to output: color, depth, ir, or pointcloud.

key_params.name: format
key_params.note: Common TOP pixel format for preserving data textures.

common_gotchas: Requires a configured primary Orbbec TOP; the Select TOP does not connect to the camera by itself.
The primary Orbbec TOP must also be active.
Available image modes depend on the Orbbec device and primary TOP settings.
Point-cloud outputs store XYZ in RGB channels as 32-bit float data textures.
key_concepts: Retrieves additional image streams from a camera controlled by a primary Orbbec TOP.
The primary Orbbec TOP must be valid and active for the Select TOP to output video.
Selected streams include color, depth, IR, and point-cloud outputs where supported.
Resolution and frame rate are controlled by the primary Orbbec TOP.
